action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/polls.rb"
s=open(p).read()
# There are two nearly identical blocks with `question = Poll::Question.new(poll: poll)`
old='''    question = Poll::Question.new(poll: poll)
    question.copy_attributes_from_proposal(proposal)
    question_title = question.title'''
new='''    question = Poll::Question.new(poll: poll)
    question.copy_attributes_from_proposal(proposal)
    vote_type = VotationType.vote_types.keys.sample
    question.build_votation_type(vote_type: vote_type,
                                 max_votes: (3 unless vote_type == "unique"))
    question_title = question.title'''
cnt=s.count(old)
assert cnt==2, cnt
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched", cnt)
PY
